jobs.title: Works Implementation Solutions Specialist
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

**Organization:** Facilitron Inc

**About Us:** Facilitron is a funded, fast-growing (#30 in the Financial Times - America's Fastest Growing Companies in 2021) startup who partners with schools, colleges and municipalities across the United States to simplify the scheduling and maintenance of public spaces. With over 7-billion square feet of gyms, athletic fields, auditoriums, classrooms and more available to the public for rent, Facilitron is the leading marketplace for public space rentals. Today, thousands of schools and other public and private facility owners partner with Facilitron to rent and manage their real estate assets.

**Type of work:** Remote

**Salary**: $45K-$65K based on experience.

**Position**: Works Implementation Solutions Specialist

**Requirement: Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is strictly required.**

We are seeking a **Works Implementation Solutions Specialist** to assist our clients through onboarding, technical enablement, and ongoing daily operations. In this role, you will provide hands-on, high-touch support to ensure smooth rollouts and stable long-term platform use.

A background in **Maintenance & Operations (M&O)**—ideally with prior experience in a supervisory, team lead, or operational coordinator capacity—is required to understand our clients' physical/operational workflows and maintenance environments. **Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish** is strongly preferred to support our growing multi-regional account base.

**Key Responsibilities Implementation & Client Onboarding**

* Support end-to-end client implementations, helping configure systems, map workflows, and execute rollout plans under the guidance of project managers.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for operational queries and technical onboarding assistance during the client go-live phase.
* Deliver bilingual (English/Spanish) training sessions and step-by-step documentation to client end-users and maintenance teams.

**Operational & Account Support**

* Leverage M&O experience to understand client workflows, troubleshoot operational bottlenecks, and maintain system readiness.
* Triage, investigate, and resolve daily technical support tickets, escalations, and system configuration requests.
* Monitor account health, track recurring support patterns, and assist in maintaining high service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Coordinate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to escalate software bugs and advocate for client needs.

**Qualifications & Skills Required**

* **M&O Experience:** 2+ years of hands-on experience in Maintenance & Operations (M&O), preferably with past experience in a supervisory, lead technician, or coordinator role.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Comfort navigating ticketing systems, task tracking tools, and troubleshooting software configurations.
* **Problem-Solving & Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills with a client-first, detail-oriented approach to resolving technical issues.

**Preferred**

* **Tech Support & Onboarding:** Experience working in software implementation, technical support, or account support at a B2B SaaS or technology company.
* **Language Skills:** Professional fluency (verbal and written) in both **English and Spanish**.
* **Education & Experience:** Associate's or Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience in operations, technical support, or client management.

Pay: $45,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) 5% Match
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Language:

* English and Spanish (Required)

Location:

* Texas (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Accounting Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
About Uplinq

Uplinq is the AI-powered bookkeeping and tax automation platform built for small business owners. We’re re-engineering how entrepreneurs manage their finances, replacing manual bookkeeping, rules, and spreadsheets with intelligent automation that delivers real-time clarity and control.

We’re a Series A startup backed by top investors, growing fast. Our team is lean, execution-focused, and allergic to fluff. We measure success in demos booked, pipelines created, and revenue influenced.

Individual applicants residing in the US only

About the role

As a Senior Onboarding Accounting Specialist, you'll be the first point of contact for new Uplinq clients — guiding them through system setup, data clean-up, and account activation.

This is a high-touch, high-volume role: you'll juggle a large, active portfolio of clients at different onboarding stages, which means the job rewards people who communicate early and often, adapt quickly when something isn't working, and hold themselves accountable for outcomes rather than just effort.

The right candidate will have a magnetic presence on calls and an excitement about interaction with small business owners. The ideal candidate is a person the clients look forward to speaking with, someone who makes them feel confident in the investment they’ve made when choosing Uplinq.

What you'll do

Lead daily client meetings to gather financial data, clarify scope, and build trust from the first call — earning it through rapport, clarity, and follow-through, not just technical accuracy.  
Set up and configure Uplinq and QuickBooks Online accounts, including resolving integration and access issues (Plaid connections, payroll, revenue processors, inventory systems, etc) so systems sync cleanly from day one.  
Compare signed proposals to actual client needs in the first call, and flag scope or pricing mismatches immediately — to sales, to your manager, and directly to the client — rather than letting a gap surface later and erode trust.  
Manage a high volume of onboarding timelines and deliverables simultaneously, and proactively speak up when your workload or a specific account is at risk of falling behind, so it can be addressed before it becomes a bigger problem.  
Troubleshoot setup and data issues using sound accounting judgment, and treat mistakes as fast information rather than something to hide — surface them quickly, learn from them, and adjust.  
Find workarounds to keep stalled onboardings moving — manual data entry when a feed breaks, alternate document paths, creative scheduling — because an on-time, good-enough solution beats a stalled account waiting for a perfect one.  
Collaborate with Sales, Initialization, Accounting, and Tax teams to resolve handoff gaps, own your part of the process end-to-end, and transition accounts smoothly into ongoing support.

Qualifications

6+ years in a client-facing accounting or onboarding role, ideally in public or multi-client accounting firm as Senior Associate level or higher  
6+ years of daily QuickBooks use including Online setup, integrations, and troubleshooting (not desktop).  
Strong working knowledge of both cash- and accrual-based accounting.  
Demonstrated ability to manage 25+ active client relationships at once without letting communication or follow-through slip — someone who escalates early, adapts on the fly, and takes ownership of outcomes rather than absorbing pressure silently.  
A warm, confident, and memorable presence with clients — someone who builds real rapport fast, puts anxious business owners at ease, and makes a technical process feel personal rather than transactional.  
Comfortable having direct conversations with clients about scope and pricing when what they signed doesn't match what they need, and willing to admit and correct course quickly when something's off.

Why Join Us

Competitive pay + health, dental, vision, 401(k), and life insurance  
Remote-first and flexible work culture  
Clear path for career growth in a fast-growing firm  
Modern tech stack and automation-first mindset  
Supportive, collaborative team with strong systems and documentation

Compensation Range: $75,000-$85,000

The pay range for this role is:  
75,000 - 85,000 USD per year(Remote)

Pay: $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: SPP Onboarding and Growth Specialist
jobs.description:
**Innovate with purpose**

At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don't stop there: we're creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters.

Working here means you become part of a vision-driven team that's ready to tackle challenges and build cutting-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. We're remote-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks.

BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person's unique skills and experiences. We'd love to hear from you—you might be just what we're looking for, whether in this role or another.

✨ Let's give businesses more time for what matters.

**Make your impact at a leading Fintech Company**

Join BILL as an SPP Onboarding and Growth Specialist on our Supplier Payments Plus team and take end-to-end ownership of the supplier relationship from day one. Supplier Payments Plus is BILL's enterprise offering built for large suppliers who receive payments from BILL's network of hundreds of thousands of SMB customers. The SPP team sits within the Solutions Consulting org and operates at the intersection of implementation, customer success, and revenue growth for some of the largest and most strategically important accounts on the platform.

In this role, you will own the full lifecycle of your supplier accounts: onboarding new customers onto SPP, driving activation and adoption, providing ongoing support and retention coverage, and identifying upsell opportunities that expand revenue within the portfolio. Your work directly determines how quickly large suppliers realize value from SPP and how long they stay. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role built for someone who is comfortable being the primary point of contact for enterprise supplier accounts and who can move between technical implementation work and commercial conversations without losing stride.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own end-to-end onboarding for new SPP supplier accounts, including configuration, integration setup, and go-live milestones.
* Serve as the primary post-sale point of contact for a portfolio of enterprise supplier accounts, managing day-to-day relationships and escalations.
* Drive product adoption and activation by guiding suppliers through key SPP features: payment routing, consolidated remittance, ERP integrations, and reporting.
* Monitor account health, proactively identify churn risk, and execute retention strategies to protect and grow revenue within the portfolio.
* Identify and close upsell opportunities within existing accounts, partnering with the broader SPP sales team to expand feature adoption and contract value.
* Deliver white-glove support for enterprise accounts, triaging and resolving technical and operational issues with speed and ownership.
* Maintain accurate account documentation in Salesforce and Gainsight, tracking activation status, health scores, and expansion pipeline.
* Contribute to process improvements and playbook development as the SPP motion scales, sharing patterns and learnings with peers and leadership.

**We'd love to chat if you have:**

* 3+ years of experience in SaaS onboarding, implementation, customer success, or account management with a track record of owning post-sale relationships end-to-end.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple enterprise accounts simultaneously, balancing onboarding workloads, active support queues, and growth priorities.
* Strong technical aptitude and comfort working through integrations, remittance file formats, and payment workflow configurations with supplier teams.
* Experience driving upsell or expansion revenue within an existing customer portfolio, including identifying signals and running the commercial conversation.
* Proficiency in Salesforce for account management and documentation; Gainsight experience is a plus.
* Clear, direct communication skills with the ability to work across both technical stakeholders and executive or finance-side contacts at large supplier organizations.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience in fintech, payments, or financial operations software, particularly in AP/AR or supplier-facing contexts.
* Familiarity with ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) and remittance or cash application workflows used by enterprise finance teams.

  

*Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must have authorization to work in the United States without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.*

**What's in it for you?**

Redefining how businesses automate their work is a fast-paced, exciting, and fun environment. But we also have benefits and perks to ensure the magic isn't only experienced by our customers, but by our employees as well.

Here is a preview of some of the amazing benefits here at BILL:

* 100% paid employee health, dental, and vision plans (choose HMO, PPO, or HDHP)
* HSA & FSA accounts
* Life Insurance, Long & Short-term disability coverage
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* 11+ Observed holidays and wellness days and flexible time off
* Employee Stock Purchase Program with employee discounts
* Wellness & Fitness initiatives
* Employee recognition and referral programs
* And much more

Don't believe us? Check out our culture, benefits, and teams on our career site, LinkedIn Life, or YouTube pages.

BILL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe our best ideas come from the unique stories, perspectives, and experiences of our team members. We welcome people of all backgrounds, abilities, and identities to bring their authentic selves and contribute to our culture.

We are committed to a transparent, inclusive hiring process that reflects our values. If you need accommodations at any stage, please contact interviewaccommodations@hq.bill.com. To ensure a fair evaluation, our Candidate Integrity Policy prohibits the use of unapproved external assistance, including generative AI, during live interviews or assessments. Doing so will result in a review and potential disqualification.

Our Applicant Privacy Notice describes how BILL treats the personal information it receives from applicants.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist**

*This role is full-time and remote in the USA.*

The **Implementation Specialist** (IS) leads clients through their ELC (Experiential Learning Cloud) onboarding journey, serving as the primary day-to-day point of contact from Kickoff Meeting through launch. They guide each institution through critical stages from kickoff and database setup through coaching transition and go-live, ensuring customers successfully adopt the platform and realize its value. The Implementation Specialist coordinates across internal teams (Support, Account Management), manages stakeholder expectations, and proactively identifies risks that could derail the implementation. They combine project management discipline with customer empathy, translating complex product features into practical workflows aligned to each client's unique needs.

**Responsibilities**

**Implementation Leadership & Project Management**

* Own the end-to-end onboarding timeline for multiple, simultaneous customer implementations, tracking progress through all stages of the implementation checklist
* Schedule and facilitate kickoff meetings, initial setup reviews, database review sessions, and coaching transitions ensuring all parties are aligned and informed
* Set and manage realistic go-live dates with customers, accounting for their availability, complexity, and dependencies; flag timeline risks early

**Customer Relationship & Communication**

* Serve as the customer's first and primary point of contact from initial kickoff through go-live, building trust and confidence in the onboarding process
* Translate customer goals and constraints into implementation scope, making trade-off recommendations when needed
* Deliver clear, regular status updates both internally and to customers highlighting progress, risks, and next steps in plain language
* Identify and escalate customer frustrations, adoption blockers, or engagement gaps before they jeopardize the implementation

**Coordination & Problem-Solving**

* Coordinate with Product and Support teams on questions, feature requests, or technical issues that arise during implementation
* Collaborate with Account Management on renewal planning and expansion opportunities post-launch
* Manage scope and expectations, protecting the implementation timeline from scope creep while advocating for reasonable customer needs

**Database Design & Technical Oversight**

* Work with Product and customers to design the ELC database structure (student groups, placement workflows, field experience bundles) that aligns to their program's processes
* Set up and create elements of client’s database
* Conduct database reviews with customers to validate the build against their requirements and best practices
* Understand core ELC functionality (site placement, groups and assignments, data management, integrations) at a level needed to advise customers and coordinate technical setup

**Documentation & Knowledge Management**

* Document each customer's unique configuration, go-live date, key stakeholders, and any special requirements in Jira and supporting systems
* Create or customize onboarding templates to reflect current best practices
* Contribute feedback from customer implementations to continuously improve the onboarding process

**Required Qualifications & Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Education, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
* 2-4 years in project management, customer success, or implementation roles in SaaS or EdTech with experience onboarding higher education institutions strongly preferred
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and customer relationships
* Strong organizational and time-management skills; comfort with tools like Jira, spreadsheets, and project timelines
* Excellent verbal and written communication; ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
* Problem-solver and self-starter who takes ownership of challenges and collaborates across teams to resolve them
* Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities; adaptability in a growing organization

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in higher education, EdTech, or non-profit sectors
* Familiarity with instructional design, experiential learning, or field experience program models
* Experience with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence) or similar project management platforms
* Background in software implementation, data migration, or system integration projects
* Project Management certification (PMP, CAPM, or similar)

**The Essentials**

* Fully remote in the USA. We provide all necessary equipment and a monthly tech stipend for your home office
* A global team with local connections. Work with talented Lumiverians worldwide
* Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Lumivero participates in E-Verify. All offers are contingent upon successful confirmation of employment eligibility

**Compensation + Benefits**

* Base salary is $55,000-$65,000 with eligibility to earn a performance-based annual bonus
* Benefits package including generous company contribution for major medical, dental, and vision insurance with HSA and FSA options available
* Additional insurance coverage including long and short-term disability coverage, life insurance, and voluntary insurance options
* Roth and Traditional 401(k) options with a generous match, vested immediately
* Technology stipend to keep your home office running
* Flexible time off, 11 holidays, and paid sick time
* Company paid parental leave policies

**Who we are**

Lumivero empowers researchers, industry experts, and business leaders to simplify data complexity, find insights, and get clarity through human expertise, trusted data, and intelligent agents. We pair expert-built, rigorous methodology with powerful data analysis and AI-driven workflows so the people making high-stakes calls can make them with confidence.

It's trusted at serious scale. Our solutions include the #1 probabilistic risk software, the #1 QDA software, and the most cited software in their fields. More than 27,000 organizations worldwide rely on Lumivero — including around 90% of the Fortune 100 — across energy, financial services, government, defense, and manufacturing.

This tool analyzes resumes against job requirements to help identify well-suited candidates based on skills, education, and relevant experience. However, human recruiters and hiring managers remain actively involved throughout the process — they review applications, exercise independent judgment, and make all final shortlisting and hiring decisions.*

jobs.title: Recruiter/Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
About AnswerNet

AnswerNet is the brand name for the AnswerNet family of companies including AnswerNet, Inc., New AnswerNet Inc., Cerida Investment Corp., ECC (Energy Choice California), Synergy Solutions, TPV.com, and Ansercomm to name a few. Together with our affiliates, AnswerNet operates more than 20 contact centers within the continental United States and Canada. We provide a vast range of services to optimize telephone answering services, appointment setting and confirmation, customer support, third-party verification, sales, lead qualification, market research, and a host of other contact management solutions. In all, AnswerNet has more than 10,000 satisfied clients and we process over 125 million interactions per year.

  

Job Summary:

We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Recruiter & Onboarding Specialist to manage full-lifecycle talent acquisition and candidate onboarding for our growing remote workforce. In this role, you will be primarily responsible for sourcing, vetting, and onboarding high-volume Technical Support Representatives (TSRs) who provide front-line technical support, account billing assistance, and network troubleshooting for wireless telecommunications subscribers operating on major nationwide networks.

In addition to core talent acquisition and onboarding duties, you will collaborate closely with our Marketing Team to enhance employer branding and execute recruitment campaigns across social media channels (LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Instagram) to engage qualified, tech-savvy applicants.

* **Core Responsibilities**

* **Talent Acquisition & High-Volume Sourcing**

* **High-Volume Technical Sourcing:** Manage active talent pipelines to recruit Technical Support Representatives capable of handling softphone inbound/outbound calls, website navigation, warranty handling, and subscriber de-escalation.
* **Pre-Hire Evaluation & Assessment:** Administer and score pre-hire assessments evaluating baseline competency in typing speed, grammar, spelling, listening comprehension, and customer empathy.
* **Shift & Operational Availability Alignment:** Screen candidates to ensure complete availability for 40-hour weekly full-time schedules across the client’s operational hours.

* **Candidate Onboarding & Compliance Management**

* **Full Onboarding Lifecycle:** Guide candidates seamlessly from contingent offer acceptance through background checks, compliance documentation, company onboarding within the HRIS system, and day-one training launch, maintaining active communication to eliminate drop-offs.
* **Background Vetting:** Initiate and review mandatory 7-year background checks to ensure compliance with company and client security standards.
* **Training Class Readiness:** Collaborate with Operations and Training leads to ensure 100% candidate show-up rates and technical readiness for paid training cohorts.

* **Recruitment Marketing & Social Media Collaboration**

* **Marketing Alignment:** Partner with the Marketing Department to align recruitment messaging, visual assets, and employer branding with company standards.
* **Social Media Campaign Execution:** Assist in drafting, scheduling, and publishing recruitment post copy, job announcements, and visual banners across social media platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Instagram).
* **Applicant Engagement:** Monitor social channel responses, direct messages, and comments to actively convert passive interest into active applicant submissions.

* **Technical Workspace & Hardware Vetting Standards**

* Auditing candidate home equipment against non-negotiable technical requirements prior to extending offers.

* **Candidate Qualifications**

* **Recruitment & Onboarding Experience:** 2+ years of experience in full-lifecycle recruiting and onboarding, preferably in high-volume call center, customer service, or remote technical support environments.
* **Technical Workspace Auditing Skills:** Ability to verify candidate home hardware specifications, interpret remote internet speed test results, and evaluate hardware compatibility.
* **Social Media & Recruitment Marketing:** Demonstrated experience posting job openings on social media platforms, writing engaging candidate-facing copy, and partnering with marketing teams.

jobs.title: Training Specialist - Financial Solutions Knowledge Group (FSKG)
jobs.description:
The Bloomberg Financial Solutions department is at the forefront of ensuring success for our customers and employees alike. Our team comprises several key pillars: sales, service, operations, culture and brand. As a department, we are united by a common goal: We create meaningful relationships with clients by understanding their needs and delivering exceptional end-to-end support from sales and implementation, through their ongoing relationship with Bloomberg.

**Our Team**

  

The Financial Solutions Knowledge Group is responsible for building and delivering thoughtful training programs that support the execution of Bloomberg strategy across Financial Solutions. The team strategizes together with senior management in order to design, organize, schedule and execute large scale trainings so that our clients can be served in the best possible way by the most knowledgeable salesforce.

**What's the role?**

  

This role, reporting to the Regional Financial Solutions Knowledge Group Team Leader, will be responsible for all matters related to developing and maintaining the skills and knowledge necessary to the success of our Bloomberg Financial Solutions employees in the region. Trainings can be in-person or remote, live or on-demand, synchronous or asynchronous, or web-based. A sophisticated learning management system keeps track of all learning activities in real time. Subject matter ranges from basic financial concepts to options pricing theory. Trainings also include sales models, behavioral heuristics, navigating complex organizations.

**We will trust you to:**

  

• Be able to propose ad-hoc trainings as solutions to business challenges

  

• Define and design programs that are aligned with department strategy and have clear business impact

  

• Understand and incorporate industry, competitive and market trends in class design

  

• Develop methods to measure training success and to collect feedback

  

• Create resources, communication, websites, enrollment processes around each training program

  

• Have a vision for the future of the team, current industry trends, and be able to drive new initiatives

  

• Manage and run a training calendar and coordinate all logistical processes from start to finish

**You will need to have:**

  

• 3+ years of a proven track record working within customer support or sales organizations

  

• Ability to investigate, understand and improve complex and highly detailed processes

  

• Comprehensive understanding of the Enterprise Sales process and the full Book-of-Business offerings. Deep knowledge of Tier 1 and Tier 2 client workflows and industry trends across the financial markets

  

• Ease of learning new software like file sharing systems, learning management systems or video editing

  

• Attention to detail, keen observation skills and time management skills

  

• The drive to both gain and share knowledge

  

• The ability to solve unstructured problems

  

• A talent for managing without authority, influence up and network

  

• Strong presentation and communication skills

  

• A “make it happen” personality and the ability to work under pressure and to deal with tight deadlines

**We'd love to see:**

  

• Passion for learning and development

  

• Keen interest in the latest methods and practices in the education space

  

• Drive and curiosity with excellent work ethic

Salary Range = 125,000 - 200,000 USD Annual + Benefits + Bonus

The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level.  
  
  

We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) +match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns.

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our podcast series for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

jobs.title: Training Specialist
jobs.description:
The Training Specialist will report to the Senior Manager of Operations Quality & Training will be responsible for the design, development, implementation, coordination, and facilitation of the Operations training and development program. The Training Specialist will work in collaboration with Operations leadership and the executive team to support key business and people objectives. They will work on business-specific strategic imperatives that focus on assessing and diagnosing organizational needs, driving change, and delivering best-in-class training solutions to support the business strategy. The right candidate will be driven by the opportunity to learn, grow and push their professional boundaries.  
  
 **JOB QUALIFICATIONS: KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES**  
  
The Training Specialists’ responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Works with the Manager of Operations Training to develop an end-to-end training roadmap and training calendar, as per business needs, in association with department leaders to deliver appropriate and effective training.
* Ensures execution of training policy across a diverse workforce including diverse locations and skill sets. Elevate skill levels by effective coordination and presentation of training and development programs.
* Assesses training needs, defines training requirements, and develops training plan which contains measurement of success to support Operations.
* Design, develop and implement training content using different learning modalities for internal employees and external customers in partnership with internal subject matter experts.
* Creates different learner journeys based on job roles, competency levels and training needs.
* Create content that addresses skill and knowledge gaps, need for improvement, or change in processes.
* Owns, evaluates, and constantly improves the New Hire Orientation. Collaborate with each of the operational areas to create content for Department specific New Hire Orientations.
* Along with business partners, identify individual and team weaknesses and work with subject matter experts to create and deliver refresher training in partnership with Quality and department leaders.
* Conducts training for new hires and refresher training across all levels of the operations areas.
* Track training progress, monitor access, and consistently strive to improve effectiveness of training delivered to ensure incorporation of taught skills and techniques into employees work behavior.
* Develops and implement effective ways to conduct training and make it fun through workshops, training retreats, gamification etc.
* Support the development and implementation of change enablement strategies, processes, and methodologies, including change management and training. Provides guidance and support for all change enablement initiatives and/or corporate projects that contain aspects of change. Optimizes key business processes by providing product, technical and compliance knowledge training.
* Oversees all lesson plans for each application by ensuring quality assurance checks are in place and that training captures both system and workflow process.
* Partner closely with other Application Team leads and ensure training needs are met and executed efficiently.
* Updates management and stakeholders during regular meetings on training program status and updates.
* Stay abreast of the new trends and tools in employee learning and development.

WHAT WILL YOU LEARN IN THE FIRST 6 MONTHS:

* Integra Partner’s business model and its role in providing health care services to our customers
* In-depth understanding of Integra Partner’s business processes and technical systems that support our core operations
* Working knowledge of Eloomi, Integra Partner’s new learning management tool
* Understanding and alignment of the training department’s strategic and tactical goals with organizational and business priorities

WHAT WILL YOU ACCOMPLISH IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS:

* Develop and implement new hire and refresher training programs for select operational areas
* Implement and maintain Integra’s new learning management software
* Develop best-in-class learning content based on different learner personas
* Implement and track learning metrics to measure the effectiveness of the training program
* Develop key processes to use feedback from training assessments, the quality assurance team and leaders to design individual training plans to help improve employee performance

**EDUCATION:**

* BS or BA Degree in Business Management, Human Resources, Engineering, Education and Learning, Applied Behavioral Science, Organizational Development, or related field required, or 2 Years of experience in training & development in lieu of degree.

**EXPERIENCE:**

* 2+ Years of experience in Training & Development, healthcare experience preferred in a training environment.
* Knowledge and practical experience within the healthcare industry, including pre-authorization, utilization reviews, medical claims processing, healthcare operations workflows, and regulatory/compliance requirements.
* Proven experience in designing multiple training events in a corporate setting.
* Extensive knowledge of instructional design theory and learning principles.
* Familiarity with traditional and modern training methods, tools, and techniques.
* Experience training for call center or Operations areas in the health care industry preferred.
* Adequate knowledge of learning management software. Experience using training tools such as Articulate or Captivate and learning management solutions preferred.
* Experience using learning management software such as Eloomi preferred.
* Understanding of career development and employee engagement practices and experience measuring engagement and implementing practices to increase organizational performance.
* Demonstrated enthusiasm about the growth and development of people to reach their full potential through skill building experiences.
* Ability to execute and thrive in a fast paced, changing, matrixed and highly collaborative environment.
* Must be able to manage large scale, complex projects for the company on time, within budget and with agreed upon deliverables.
* Strong facilitation, communication, presentation and training skills.
* Ability to lead and motivate others.
* Ability to interact effectively across all levels of the organization.
* Experience from consultation to development and implementation of initiatives.
* Self-motivated, entrepreneurial attitude with a willingness to do whatever it takes to get things done.

SALARY: $62,500.00/annually

**Benefits Offered**

* Competitive compensation and annual bonus program
* 401(k) retirement program with company match
* Company-paid life insurance
* Company-paid short term disability coverage (location restrictions may apply)
* Medical, Vision, and Dental benefits
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Paid Parental Leave
* Sick Time
* Paid company holidays and floating holidays
* Quarterly company-sponsored events
* Health and wellness programs
* Career development opportunities

**Remote Opportunities**

We are actively seeking new colleagues in: Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Kentucky, Massachusetts, Michigan, North Carolina, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

**Our Story**

Founded in 2005, Integra Partners is a leading national durable medical equipment, prosthetic, and orthotic supplies (DMEPOS) network administrator. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for the communities we serve by reimagining access to in-home healthcare. We connect Payers, Providers, and Members through innovative technology and streamlined workflows affording Members access to top local Providers and culturally competent care. By focusing on transparency, accountability, and adaptability, we help deliver better health outcomes and more efficient management of complex healthcare benefits.

With a location in Michigan plus a remote workforce across the United States, Integra has a culture focused on collaboration, teamwork, and our values: One Team, Drive Results, Push the Boundaries, Value Others, and Build Community. We’re looking for energetic, talented, and dedicated individuals to join our team. See what opportunities we have available; there may be a role for you to engage in a challenging yet rewarding career in healthcare. We look forward to learning more about you.

Integra Partners is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations and will work with you to meet your needs. If you are a person with a disability and require assistance during the application process, please don’t hesitate to reach out. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** EHR Analyst, Senior  
**Department:** Ambulatory Application  
**Location:** Riedman - Remote  
**Hours Per Week:** 40  
**Schedule:** Full-Time, Day-Shift, Monday to Friday, (8 am - 4:00 pm)

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
The EHR Application Analyst Senior serves as an advanced-level contributor in the support, optimization, and ongoing development of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role handles complex technical issues, leads system optimization efforts, and serves as a resource and mentor for junior analysts. The EHR Application Analyst Senior applies deep knowledge of EHR capabilities and healthcare business workflows to drive improvements that enhance clinical and operational performance.  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Advanced System Support and Maintenance:
* Serve as a primary escalation point for complex technical issues and system errors, applying advanced troubleshooting techniques to ensure timely resolution and minimal disruption to patient care.
* Provide day-to-day technical support to end-users, including troubleshooting issues, answering questions, and resolving system errors to ensure uninterrupted use of the EHR system.
* Provide guidance to junior analysts on day-to-day support challenges, sharing expertise and building team capability.
* Lead and coordinate routine maintenance activities, including software updates, patches, and upgrades, to ensure the stability and security of the EHR system.
* Coordinate testing and validation activities for system changes, enhancements, and upgrades, ensuring new features meet functional requirements without introducing unintended disruptions.
* Participate in on-call rotations, including taking lead responsibility for after-hours coverage on complex or escalated issues.

System Optimization:

* Lead efforts to optimize the performance, usability, and efficiency of the EHR system.
* Conduct workflow assessments with operational partners to identify build inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and advance optimization requests through appropriate governance and change management channels.
* Apply cross-application integration knowledge to identify dependencies and ensure cohesive system performance across modules.

Collaboration and Vendor Engagement:

* Take ownership of defined work streams or components within EHR implementation projects, system upgrades, and other initiatives.
* Coordinate task assignments, track progress, and communicate status to project leads, ensuring deliverables are completed on time and within scope.
* Own ongoing relationships with EHR vendor support, including managing open support requests, evaluating release notes for operational impact, and representing the organization in user group sessions and advisory forums.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams - including IT, clinicians, administrators, and vendors - to support EHR initiatives and facilitate effective communication across stakeholder groups.

Documentation and Knowledge Management:

* Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, processes, and procedures.
* Establish knowledge-sharing practices to ensure critical information is accessible and current across the team.

Training and Mentorship:

* Provide training and mentorship to junior analysts and end-users, sharing best practices to enhance team capabilities and support continuous professional development.

Compliance and Data Privacy

* Handle all protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations and organizational data privacy and security policies.
* Complete required compliance training and model information security best practices for the team.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

* Excellent analytical, organization, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and within teams.
* Ability to solve complex problems and understand translate customer needs into system solutions.
* Strong understanding of healthcare business process, workflows, and terminology.
* Cross-application integration knowledge.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity tools.
* Degree in Computer Science, healthcare or related field.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  

* Minimum two (2) to five (5) years of experience as an EHR Application Analyst, Health IT Analyst, Epic Analyst, or in a related healthcare information systems role.

LICENSURE/CERTIFICATIONS:

  

* Current Epic Certification.
